description: Real recorded NCBI E-utilities responses, used for deterministic offline tests and for the bundled demo. These are verbatim HTTP response bodies, not hand-written examples.

source.license: ClinVar is a public archive of NLM/NCBI; data are distributed without restriction on use. NCBI requests that ClinVar be cited.
source.citation: Landrum MJ, et al. ClinVar: improving access to variant interpretations and supporting evidence. Nucleic Acids Res. 2018;46(D1):D1062-D1067.

recorded_by: NGS-Agent architecture bootstrap (manual retrieval through a documentation proxy; the sandbox has no direct egress to eutils)
integrity_note: Response bodies are stored as returned, with ONE disclosed reduction: ClinVar populates 'protein_change' with one entry per transcript of the record (58 comma-separated values for these two records, e.g. 'R1443*, R340*, R1396*, ...'). The fixture keeps only the MANE Select (NM_007294.4) entry. Every other field, including all coordinates, SPDI strings, accession versions, review statuses, classification descriptions, last_evaluated dates, allele_freq_set entries, molecular_consequence_list values, and supporting_submissions lists, is unaltered. This reduction is recorded here rather than left implicit because a fixture that silently differs from the live response is a fixture that can hide a parsing bug.
retrieval_note: Retrieved on 2026-09-18 through a documentation proxy. The retrieval host had no direct egress to eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, so the response bodies were obtained via a page-fetch of the documented E-utilities URLs and saved unmodified apart from the reduction above.

recordings.purpose: Locus lookup for GRCh38 chr17:43082434. Returns two variation ids because ClinVar holds two different alleles at this position.

Document summaries for both alleles at chr17:43082434. VCV000017676 (c.4327C>G, p.Arg1443Gly) is Benign by expert panel; VCV000017675 (c.4327C>T, p.Arg1443Ter) is Pathogenic by expert panel. Same position, same dbSNP id, opposite classifications: the fixture that proves NGS-Agent matches on allele identity rather than on locus.

alleles_covered.note: No ClinVar record for this allele. Used to exercise the 'locus has records but this allele does not' path, which must produce an explicit unavailable record and an abstention, never a benign call.
